speaking.title: 商务会议开场白

dialogue.text: Good morning everyone, let's get started with today's agenda.
Sure, I'd like to go over the quarterly report first.

speaking.phrases: get started: 开始; go over: 回顾/检查; quarterly report: 季度报告

speaking.title: 面试自我介绍

dialogue.text: Tell me about yourself and your professional background.
I have five years of experience in digital marketing, specializing in content strategy and social media management.

speaking.phrases: professional background: 职业背景; specializing in: 专攻于

speaking.title: 餐厅点餐

dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to order the grilled salmon with a side salad, please.
Excellent choice! Would you like any drinks with that?

speaking.phrases: I'd like to order: 我想点; side salad: 配菜沙拉

speaking.title: 问路指路

dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?
Sure, just go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the traffic light.

speaking.phrases: how to get to: 怎么去; go straight: 直走; turn left: 左转

speaking.title: 客户电话沟通

dialogue.text: I'm calling to follow up on the proposal we sent last week.
Thanks for following up. We've reviewed it and have a few questions.

speaking.phrases: follow up on: 跟进; proposal: 提案

speaking.title: 旅行订酒店

dialogue.text: I'd like to check in. I have a reservation under the name Wang.
Let me look that up. Yes, a deluxe room for three nights, is that correct?

speaking.phrases: check in: 入住; reservation: 预订; deluxe room: 豪华房

listening.title: TED: The Power of Vulnerability
listening.content: Brené Brown discusses how vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation and creativity.
listening.exercises: 听后回答：What is the main message of this talk?

listening.title: BBC: The English We Speak - "A Piece of Cake"
listening.content: Learn what "a piece of cake" really means and how to use it in British English.
listening.exercises: 请用 "a piece of cake" 造3个句子

listening.title: VOA: Business English - Negotiation Skills
listening.content: Key phrases and strategies for successful business negotiations in English.
listening.exercises: 学习并练习商务谈判中的常用句型

listening.title: BBC: 6 Minute English - Climate Change
listening.content: Discussion about climate change vocabulary and environmental terms.
listening.exercises: 听后列出5个环境相关词汇

listening.title: TED: How Great Leaders Inspire Action
listening.content: Simon Sinek explains the Golden Circle concept.
listening.exercises: What is the Golden Circle? How does it apply to leadership?

The new software will streamline our workflow significantly.
We use industry benchmarks to measure our performance.

Our team follows agile methodology for faster delivery.
We achieved a 30% ROI on our digital marketing campaign.
The project deliverables are due by the end of this week.

vocab.definition: 有韧性的，能迅速恢复的
vocab.example: She is remarkably resilient in the face of challenges.
His eloquent speech moved everyone in the audience.
The benevolent donor supported many local charities.
The artist is known for her whimsical style.
The book had a profound impact on my understanding of history.
She is a versatile performer who can sing, dance, and act.
There is a subtle difference between confidence and arrogance.

vocab.definition: 一丝不苟的，极其仔细的
vocab.example: The meticulous editor caught every single typo.
The old song filled her with a sense of nostalgia.
Meeting her was pure serendipity.
